formula: Per serial process: median of 8 historical incremental 512-prompt/512-generation HF case walls × cases +180 s process/model-load margin. Per-case range 800–1600 s plus one 180 s margin per process. The 1024-prompt added case has no matched HF timing baseline; same broad range is applied as a conservative provisional envelope because decode dominates observed 512 cases, and this remains an assumption, not a benchmark. For the unmatched 2048-prompt case, point reuses the 512-prompt historical median only as a placeholder; case range widens from 800–1600 to 800–3200 seconds (2x the prior upper bound) because prompt/prefill cost lacks a matched or isolated timing basis.

groups.uncertainty: 2048 prompt = 4x the 512-token prefix; no matched HF timing or separate prefill component. Point is inherited historical median and should not be read as expected measured duration; upper interval is a deliberately widened sensitivity envelope.
